title: Outstandingly Fresh Peruvian Broad Beans Causa Limena
description: A traditional Peruvian dish featuring broad beans, with an earthy and springy flavor, made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients and nimono simmer method, presented in a causa limena form.

ingredients.name: Chili peppers
ingredients.notes: diced, depending on desired spice level

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the broad beans for 5 minutes.
Drain the broad beans and rinse them with cold water to stop the cooking process.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the diced chili peppers to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked broad beans, sauteed onion and garlic mixture, and diced yellow potatoes.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top of the broad bean mixture and toss to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
To assemble the causa limena, create a layer of the broad bean mixture on a serving plate, followed by a layer of diced yellow potatoes.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of broad bean mixture on top.
Garnish the top of the causa limena with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
